name: Docks
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. There are large open crates piled here, all
desc3: empty. The boat berths are empty also, echoing the effect of the
desc4: recent decrease in traffic to and from Silvermere. The street
desc5: continues to the east and west, with River street running parallel off
